# CG-SCHEMA-001: Incompatible type change

The base and candidate type sets are disjoint.

**Why it matters:** Disjoint types break both senders and readers.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Schemas](./#schema) |
| Detects | `schema.typeChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: critical · potentially breaking: high · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Type of {where} changed incompatibly ({from} → {to}).
>
> No value valid before is valid now, in either direction.
>
> **Fix:** Keep the previous type, introduce a new field instead, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: request string → object

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, critical. Type of POST /x: the request body (application/json) changed incompatibly (string → object).

### Fires: response array → string

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: array}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, critical. Type of GET /x: response 200 (application/json) changed incompatibly (array → string).

### Does not fire: integer → number

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: integer}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: number}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

### Does not fire: [string, 'null'] → string

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: [string, 'null']}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
